milestone.name: TPC-1 typed premise certificate schema
milestone.revision: TPC-1 unifies the tested transversal pattern: classify evidence by origin, freeze exact identities, apply only matching admission predicates, use bounded semantic parsers/rules, and propagate the conjunction of parent scopes without trust amplification. It distinguishes own repository identity, provider-verified commits, provider-verified annotated tags, lightweight-tag-to-verified-commit fallback, declared config, derived facts, rejected external observations and rejected raw signatures.

opaque_execution.rule: must remain an explicit unresolved child, never encoded as DECLARED_CONFIG or raw signature text

negative_evidence: Origin types are not a numeric trust ranking; fallback requires independent evidence for the fallback origin.
Mutable branch/release names are discovery pointers, not final immutable anchors.
DERIVED facts cannot broaden the scope of any parent premise.
Repository-provider verification is provider trust, not independent cryptographic verification.

frontier.action: Build an outcome boundary table mapping build/test outcome classes to certificate-only replacement conditions and exact counterexamples.
